description:
`HipDispatcher` in `crates/gf2-sim/src/gpu/mod.rs` binds its stream pool to a single device, so a simulation uses one GPU.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The dispatcher holds one stream pool per selected device, and a fixed seed and configuration produce identical results for every supported device count, covered by the shared pipeline suite on a multi-device host or a tested fallback on a single-device host.
- [hard] REQ-02: A recoverable failure on one device selects the tested fallback per `@/inv/accelerator-safe-fallback`.
title: Per-device HIP stream pools for multi-GPU simulation
